# motion-pages — award-site motion, one prompt away

> Open-source Claude Code skill (MIT) that teaches an AI agent to build immersive,
> award-site-style Three.js landing pages as single self-contained HTML files —
> foggy hero worlds, glass product stages, dome media galleries, scroll-driven
> camera journeys with particle morphs, walkable procedural game worlds — screenshot-verified across desktop,
> tablet and phone before shipping.

## Core

- [SKILL.md (the full skill — read this to build pages)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/SKILL.md)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/README.md)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages)

## Live examples (view source for working reference code)

- [Sylva replica — foggy living-world hero, scan intro, creature](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/sylva-replica.html)
- [Fernline — the hero applied to a fictional SaaS brand](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/fernline-hero.html)
- [SONA·1 — glass product stage, fresnel shader, sonar rings](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/sona-product-hero.html)
- [Archive° — drag-orbit dome gallery, click-to-focus camera flight](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/dome-gallery.html)
- [BOREAL — scroll-scrubbed camera rail, particle shape morphs](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/boreal-journey.html)
- [PURA — liquid-glass ripple typography, raw WebGL, no three.js](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/pura-liquid-hero.html)
- [Paperworks* — springy draggable poster wall, pure DOM](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/paperworks-posterwall.html)
- [HALDE — cursor-trail image reveal: prints surface under the pointer, pure DOM](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/halde-trail.html)
- [KILN — horizontal scroll-snap story: wheel drives a sideways rail, 3-speed parallax, pure DOM](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/kiln-horizontal.html)
- [ALDER — scroll-scrubbed process reveal: the pinned hero raises a cabin as you scroll, then hands off to the business page, pure DOM + canvas](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/alder-build.html)
- [HOLLOWMERE — live game-world hero: a walkable procedural forest (canvas-painted textures, leaf-card canopies, wind, shadow maps, IBL, a pond — zero image assets), the game's HUD as chrome, a trailer shot from the same scene](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/hollowmere-world.html)
- [VOLERA — particle shape morph: crane → V-flock → moon gate](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/volera-morph.html)
- [TEMPO — the easing grammar as an interactive one-file reference](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/examples/tempo-easing.html)

## Build-spec prompts (the full spec that produces each demo — copy, re-theme, build)

Not one-liners: each pins the layer stack, palette values, geometry parameters,
shader math, timings, responsive rules and the self-verify recipe. Fetch the one
nearest the task before writing code.

- [Sylva replica](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/prompts/sylva-replica.txt)
- [Fernline](https://jiangyurong609.github.io/motion-pages/prompts/fernline-hero.txt)

## Usage

In Claude Code, install the plugin:

```
/plugin marketplace add jiangyurong609/motion-pages
/plugin install motion-pages@motion-pages
```

Manually (forks, offline machines, other agents): `cp -r motion-pages ~/.claude/skills/`,
or paste SKILL.md into any coding agent's context.

Then prompt e.g. "Build a 3D product hero like AETHER — fresnel-glass case, sonar
rings, orbital arcs. Self-verify until perfect."

This file is the live index — SKILL.md ships a snapshot of the demo list that goes
stale between releases, so prefer the links above when you have network access.

## Tooling (zero-dependency, Node ≥22 + Chrome)

- [scripts/study.mjs — "clone the feel of this URL": storyboard, motion probes, palette/type, tech signals → build-spec prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/scripts/study.mjs)
- [scripts/audit.mjs — headless design lint, ~22 rules × 3 viewports, exit 1 on blockers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/scripts/audit.mjs)
- [scripts/picker.js — DevTools element picker → precise context block for the agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/scripts/picker.js)
- [scripts/check-catalog.mjs — asserts this index, the prompts, SKILL.md and the demo counts still agree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiangyurong609/motion-pages/main/scripts/check-catalog.mjs)
